viewpoint_distribution.semantic_description: CVPR 2019: 1=No Wear (flat-lay/hanger/ghost mannequin), 2=Frontal (front view on person), 3=Side/Back (profile/back view on person)

occlusion_distribution.semantic_description: CVPR 2019: Landmark-based occlusion definition: Slight/Partial (<20% landmarks occluded), Heavy (>50% landmarks occluded), Medium (otherwise, 20%-50%). Stored as discrete codes 1, 2, 3 in JSON.

zoom_distribution.semantic_description: CVPR 2019: Qualitative annotation categories based on garment landmark truncation (landmarks falling outside the image frame): 1=No Zoom, 2=Medium Zoom, 3=Large Zoom, without claiming exact numeric proportion rules.

scale_distribution.semantic_description: CVPR 2019: 1=Small, 2=Modest, 3=Large. Discrete semantic scales without arbitrary percentage area thresholds.
